stage: offline local-greedy oracle diagnosis, not a deployable index or global upper bound
score: original ascending-dimension RN-FP64 squared L2, separate multiply/add; unchanged cache and U*
certificate: only PCA8 signed outward FP32 AABB, 64 B/region, ETA=1e-8, RHO=1e-4; no native bound
projection: unchanged stored PCA8 basis; columns 8:16 of frozen projected cache; no refit

proposal_contract.axis_ties: lower dimension wins; spread measured on frozen FP64 coordinates
proposal_contract.sort_ties: ascending object ID; S10 lex keys (z_a,z_b,ID)
proposal_contract.cyclic: parent depth modulo 8; root depth 0 uses PC1
proposal_contract.radial: centroid sums FP64 in ascending object-ID order with sequential accumulate per coordinate; divide by parent size; squared radius separate multiply/add in dimension order 0..7
proposal_contract.duplicates: keep all 12, including duplicate axis proposals; count exact partition-order duplicates
proposal_contract.children: sort ascending, cut ten equal contiguous children

oracle: per-parent immediate-child pruned object count; P3 sums all8, P4 hard6; lowest proposal ID on ties; no lookahead/backtracking

G4.sampling: all 100 unique parents producing L3; uniform unique frozen ordinals for L4/L5 before construction
G4.independence: independent stable-sort proposal enumeration, scalar endpoint/bound arithmetic and all 12 score vectors from frozen projected coordinates; prior original-vector/domain validation inherited, not claimed as newly repeated

gate_arithmetic: exact rational ratios from integer counts; no floating threshold tolerance
promotion: same L3 or L4: P4 hard>=0.60 and P4 hard-P2 hard>=0.25
strong: promotion holds at same ancestor AND P4 hard>=0.70 AND P3 all8>=0.60
easy_only: max P4 hard at ancestors<0.40 AND some P3 all8 ancestor>=0.60
low: max P4 hard ancestor<0.40; does NOT establish a global family upper bound
K2_diagnostic: P4 hard-P2 hard<0.10 at both ancestors, not a separate allowed decision

denominators.alignment: pruned / (query_objects - truth_retained_objects), truth reaggregated per partition

cost_scope: construction process CPU seconds, explicit-array scratch proxy, worker RSS, evaluated proposals and bounds; NO latency or deployable build-performance claim
